faq.q: How does the annual subscription work?
faq.a: With a single annual payment you get all live matches of the season and the full SANDR Replay, across multiple devices.

faq.q: What does the single-event pass include?
faq.a: The pass gives you access to a single event in HD, with no subscription. Access stays valid for 48 hours from the event date.

faq.q: How many devices can I watch on?
faq.a: You can follow SANDR across multiple devices: smart TV, computer, tablet and smartphone.

faq.q: What's the difference between the subscription and the event pass?
faq.a: The annual subscription unlocks all live matches and replays of the season. The event pass is for watching a single event with no commitment.
